key_findings: Repeated NTG caused male-specific loss of GABAergic neurons with increased DeltaFosB and active caspase-3 in neocortex, amygdala, hippocampus and locus coeruleus
Male NTG mice showed upregulated PACAP/PAC1, BDNF/TrkB and increased NKCC1 (not KCC2) in the choroid plexus, with GABA signaling genes downregulated
